# discover_parity.txt -- the shared fixture for stdlib/iduna/discover.prn. Three suites assert this same file:

#   tests/iduna/discover_test.c      the C target   (bash scripts/test_iduna_discover.sh)

#   tests/iduna/discover_test.html   the JS target  (generated by the same script; open it in a browser)
#
# One row per call: `<function> <args...> = <expected>`. The answers are the rules' own, worked by hand from the .prn.
# A row that one target fails means that target has drifted from the others.
